exit_codes.1: documented input, data, filesystem, or runtime failure

output_contract.json: After reaching result reporting, '--format json' writes one JSON value to stdout; an earlier failure may produce no JSON.
output_contract.stderr: Click errors and usage messages, plus progress or status when a command segregates it from results.
output_contract.stdout: Structured results, or human-mode results and workflow narration; human mode may include progress and validation findings.
